name: us-tax-mcp
description: NEW MEXICO, WHERE THE $4,000 DEPENDENT DEDUCTION PAYS NOTHING FOR AN ONLY CHILD - NMSA 1978 7-2-39 allows it "for each dependent IN EXCESS OF ONE", so every published account of the provision overstates the deduction by exactly $4,000 at every family size - and where 7-2-7 writes THREE rate schedules rather than five, grouping married-filing-jointly, surviving spouses and HEADS OF HOUSEHOLD under one, so a head of household read against the single column is overcharged a flat $1,319.00 at every net taxable income above $315,000; where the Social Security exemption is a LIVE CLIFF worth $2,855.65 of tax on one dollar for a couple with $60,000 of federally taxable benefit at $150,000 of AGI, on three thresholds that are NOT indexed although a published 2026 guide says they are; and where the deduction is the FEDERAL one, PIT-1 line 12. KANSAS, AND A GATE LIST THAT STOPPED BEING WRITTEN BY HAND: the thirty-second taxing state, where the K-40's FOUR filing-status boxes include no qualifying-surviving-spouse box and the head-of-household box qualifies a filer who claimed "Head of Household OR QUALIFYING WIDOW OR WIDOWER WITH A DEPENDENT CHILD" federally - so a Kansas widow is read against the HEAD-OF-HOUSEHOLD column, worth $527.48 against the joint default on a widow with one dependent child and $60,000 of federal AGI, and the correct answer sits BETWEEN the two columns a model would guess; where a $2,320 head-of-household exemption was on the Department's form a year before HB 2231 of 2025 backdated it into the statute, where 79-32,121(a)(4) gives a $2,320 exemption for a STILLBIRTH that nothing can model because no return records the fact, where KPERS, federal civil service, Thrift Savings Plan and military retired pay are exempt in full at any age and no private pension, 401(k) or IRA is exempt at all - $0.00 against $1,942.88 on the same $50,000 - and where the published minimum filing requirement is exactly the standard deduction plus the personal exemption in every status and can therefore change nobody's tax. AND THE `taxableSocialSecurity` GATE IS NOW DERIVED FROM THE ENGINE RATHER THAN LISTED: it was the last hand-written list of state codes in state-fields.ts, six consecutive new states each needed a line added to it, and the file argued five times that it was safe because the drift was caught - which is an argument for a cheaper way of being right. It is now the union of the NINE DEFINITION KEYS whose rules read the figure, so a state arriving with a mechanism this package already has gains the argument with no edit. 42 states for 2025 and 2026 and 1,033 local income taxes - New York City, Yonkers, all 24 Maryland jurisdictions, all 92 Indiana counties, all 24 Michigan cities, all 679 municipalities and all 214 Ohio school districts - and every argument refused for a state that does not read it, with a refusal naming the states that do.

scripts.build: npm run sync && rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/finalize.mjs
